chapter: Fats Pichon and the steamer Capitol
title: Joining Fats Pichon's band on the steamer Capitol and learning to read and arrange
summary: Pichon takes him on despite his not reading, teaches him reading and arranging for free on the boat in 1938, with daily band rehearsals and Basie stock arrangements.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Reading music versus faking and playing by ear
